title: 4. Qualifications and Disqualifications of Assembly Members

blocks.content:
Qualifications:
• Citizen of India
• Minimum age – 25 years
• Not holding office of profit

Disqualifications:
• Unsound mind
• Insolvency
• Disqualification under anti-defection law

rows: Citizen of India, Minimum age 25 years, Not holding office of profit
Unsound mind, Insolvency, Disqualification under anti-defection law

items: The minimum age for Assembly membership is 25 years (often confused with 30 years required for Legislative Councils).
Anti-defection law grounds are heavily tested in Indian Polity sections.
Office of Profit exceptions and disqualifications are key focus areas for competitive exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Candidates for the Assembly must be Indian citizens and at least 25 years old.
Holding an office of profit disqualifies an individual from assembly membership.
Insolvency and an unsound mind are legal grounds for disqualification.
Violation of the anti-defection law leads to immediate disqualification.
